issues.description: The Bookstore's books property is declared as private in the solution (private let books: [Book]), but Client.main (and likely tests) access bookstore.books from another file. In Swift, private restricts access to the enclosing declaration/file, so this visibility prevents other types/files from reading the books array and contradicts the problem expectation that Bookstore holds an accessible books array (and the solution itself attempts to access it). This will cause compilation errors or prevent tests from inspecting the bookstore contents.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the books property accessible to other files in the module (remove the private modifier so it is internal by default, or use fileprivate if accessing within the same file is intended, or declare it public if external access is required by tests). For example, change 'private let books: [Book]' to 'let books: [Book]'. Ensure the visibility matches what the tests and Client expect.
